pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with low-contrast, smooth edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank exhibit larger spatial areas compared to the fragmented, smaller clusters located on the lower rump and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of light-colored negative space with a high degree of connectivity. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral section, narrowing slightly toward the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude silhouette along the neck. The mane presents as a series of fine, vertical pixel clusters creating a jagged 1D geometric contour against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Distinct structural breaks are visible in the mane line, specifically at the mid-neck transition and where the mane terminates near the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three oxpecker birds perched on the hide: one on the upper neck mane, one on the dorsal rump, and one on the mid-posterior flank.
